name: expense-webapp
description: The single-page app every actor uses: employees upload receipts, correct auto-filled fields, add a note and submit claims, and see their own claims' status; managers review their team's pending claims and flags and decide them; Finance/Admin edits policy rules (by form or by plain language) and sees claims across every team. It holds no business logic of its own — every read and write goes through expense-api, receipt-agent or policy-rule-agent.
